name: receiver-system
description: Step 4 of the receiver-motion study: moving receivers through the real server. Each frame carries rx_motion (the true receiver pose, the step 3b KF estimate, or none), the server places the receiver there and models its own Doppler in the solver (retina-geolocator rx_vel_*). Each run is also solved offline from its own recording with what the server was told, for a like-for-like comparison.
